_comment: Benchmark application version manifest. Recorded alongside every experiment evidence artifact.
invariant: This exact version and configuration is deployed to BOTH AWS EKS and GCP GKE. Do not modify between cluster deployments.
notes: Image digests: resolve with `kubectl get pods -n online-boutique -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.containers[*].image}{"\n"}{end}' --context=<ctx>` after deployment.
The Online Boutique includes a built-in loadgenerator service. For controlled experiments, disable it and use the standalone Locust deployment in platform/multicloud/locust/.
